Name: The Saltwater Room - Custom Farm Type
Author: hoshikuzunosora
Description:
An expansive beach farm heavily inspired by the [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8AllgoKzRA8]Owl City song of the same name.[/url]﻿


Main features include:

- Completely custom farm type, with an icon, custom room decoration, and upgraded room gift to match. Perfect for both farming and fishing!

- Lots of space for planting, building, decorating, and ranching, each with designated zones for doing so.

- Ranching zone both has oodles of blue grass, along with invisible barriers to prevent animals from escaping

- Crab pots collect ocean fish, along with the bounty of the sea itself right at your doorstep...

[i]...and that's just the features of the farm itself!

[/i]
There's a secret hidden deep within the waves themselves... will you be able to find the saltwater room and it's treasures?

[color=#e69138]Requirements:

[/color]Content Patcher
Farm Type Manager
DaisyNiko's Tilesheets

I've tested this thoroughly for bugs, however if I missed something please don't hesitate to tell me! Along with any suggestions or feedback!

Thank you for visiting my mod! I hope you have a nice day/night
